name: Differentiable Robot Rendering (Dr. Robot)
definition: A differentiable robot rendering method that models a robot's visual appearance as a differentiable function of its control parameters (pose), integrating kinematics-aware deformation and Gaussians Splatting to enable gradient-based control and planning.
summary: Differentiable Robot Rendering uses 3D Gaussian Splatting with Linear Blend Skinning to enable gradient-based robotic control, distinguishing itself from neural refiners by effectively handling long arms and chained joints.
